verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no way to version, review, or roll back user-defined automations such as agents, workflows, or saved prompts. The closest items are model aliases, pinned model IDs, and retirement redirects. Those govern the vendor's model versions, not the user's automations, so they are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
